title: Palace: A Weekend Well Played
description: We played a lot of Palace this weekend. A lot. Strictly for testing purposes, naturally.
author: The 4OH Workshop
intro: Real games are helping us tighten the app and find the awkward edges before release. There’s a difference between “the code looks right” and “everyone at the table agrees that seven should be allowed.” We’re working on that difference.
We’re also working through the Apple installation bumps. Getting into the game shouldn’t be harder than winning it.
Palace is getting closer, but we’re not calling it finished while those issues remain. More play, more polish, fewer technical interruptions. That’s the plan.
And if another game is necessary for quality assurance, we are prepared to make that sacrifice.
